newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Socialists want to review EU budget pact.
newsitem.headline: French Socialists want to review EU budget pact.

text.p: France's opposition Socialist party wants to review a European Union budget stability pact which will fine countries whose budget deficits go over three percent of gross domestic product after the launch of monetary union, spokesman Francois Hollande said on Friday.
He said the party was opposed to an assumption implicit in the pact that there must be future reductions in budget deficits below three percent of GDP.
"We want to look at the stability pact again to get guarantees that we will not be obliged to go beyond three percent," he told Reuters.
"It is implicitly written in that we may have to go below three percent and go therefore towards an even more rigorous budgetary policy," he said.
